responsibility: Provides the central front-end hook that runs a small set of built-in self-tests when the DMD code is compiled with unit testing enabled. The file gathers unit-test entry points from support subsystems such as the spelling helper, import-hint logic, and root associative-array code, and exposes a single `unittests()` dispatcher that conditionally invokes them under `#if UNITTEST`. It is therefore the lightweight test harness aggregator for internal D front-end library checks rather than a semantic-analysis or code-generation module.
